reviews.text: This company is amazing. They just built our pool patio cover and outdoor kitchen! I can’t say enough amazingly wonderful things about this company, the guys that work for him and Jaime the owner! Jaime was great and was always here checking on the progress and very easy to work with! The guys that were here everyday building everything were the BEST! I would give this company all the stars in the world if I could. You will NOT be disappointed at all to use Azure Pools!!
reviews.author: Lyndi DeWald

reviews.text: Jaime and his crew built an incredible covered patio and kitchen. Rock work done by true artists and not average crew. 5 years and we have used it extensively. No issues. Have referred this company to three friends and all have selected Azure to build their patios. One is now using them for their new pool. Honest company who went the extra mile for us.
reviews.author: Tom Caldwell

reviews.text:
From the beginning to the end of the process it felt that we were dealing with close personal friends. I knew we had picked the right builder when I first met Jaimes Fernandes from Azure Pools.
Jaimes, all the crew and his son Matt Fernandes did an outstanding  job (art) in our backyard building our dream pool and outdoor kitchen.
We would and already have recommended Azure Pools to our friends and family.
reviews.author: alex sobral

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with this company. They not only did our pool, but also built a pergola with lights, and created a backyard paradise with landscaping, lights, and waterfall. The workers kept everything clean throughout the process, and the entire team was professional and courteous. Several of our neighbors have used this company as well. Jaime, the owner, lives in the area, so he was very hands-on. We will use them again for future projects. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Laurie Reinhold

reviews.text: Jaime and Azure Pools are amazing. We interviewed over 6 builders. None of which felt as honest as jaime. He's accommodating and goes the extra mile. He didn't nickel or dime on small changes in scope. He's committed to the customer experience and always responds to phonecalls and texts. We built a pool/spa, outdoor kitchen, covered patio, pergola and basketball court for us. Turned out beautiful. If something wasn't right he fixed it.  He's like family now. He's doing three of the neighboring pools now as well. We are very happy with Azure.
reviews.author: Mansur Masood

reviews.text: Jaime and his crew were fantastic! His team transformed our backyard into a relaxing retreat. Would definitely recommend them to our friends.
reviews.author: Mary Reeves Realtor

reviews.author: Zelio Silveira
